_readme: Game tuning. Times are in milliseconds. Edit freely; restart the app to apply.

customer._readDelay: Live read delay (customer online in the chat), by persona 'read' speed. While BalanceDesk is open, pending customer replies come twice as fast.
customer._maxTurns: Customer replies after the question before they give up.
customer._meter: Hidden impatience (0-100, never shown to the player; it sets the customer's tone). Each customer reply adds 'perReply' by persona patience; pushing back on a wrong/unclear answer adds 'pushback'. At 100 they leave. VIPs tolerate 1-3 pushbacks calmly (vipGrace), then each pushback adds vipPushback.

pay._formula: Pay = Base(rank) x VIP x (score/100) x (serviceMultBase + serviceMultPerStar*stars) x length x time x bonuses + tip

time._readme: Time factor from your average reply time: best at or under the ideal, falling linearly to 'atSlow' at the slow mark, then down to 'min' at twice the slow mark.

mentor._autoHints: Mentor messages you a hint when a customer has pushed back hintAfterPushbacks times in one chat (at most maxHintsPerChat per chat).

world._readme: Async (Telegram-like) simulation in real time. It keeps running while the app is closed and is caught up on launch.

rush._readme: Rush shift (ask your boss): a few customers who stay online and expect fast replies.

boss._readme: Your manager Diane: reachable during workHours (your local time); replies in replyDelayMs.
